title: Prediction market events
description: One item per event, from pdata.world's API. Probabilities are each venue's own market price, between 0 and 1. Data: pdata.world, CC BY 4.0.

title.title: Event
title.description: Event title as the venue publishes it.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion or gemini.

eventId.title: Event id
eventId.description: The venue's event id, unique within the venue.

topOutcome.title: Leading outcome
topOutcome.description: The outcome with the highest probability.

topOutcomeProbability.title: Leading probability
topOutcomeProbability.description: Probability of the leading outcome, 0 to 1.

topOutcomeChange24h.title: 24h change
topOutcomeChange24h.description: Change in the leading outcome's probability over 24 hours, in probability units (0.03 = 3 points).

volume24h.title: 24h volume
volume24h.description: Trading volume over 24 hours in the venue's own unit (see volumeUnit); not comparable across venues.

volumeUnit.title: Volume unit
volumeUnit.description: shares (Polymarket), contracts (Kalshi), mana (play money, Manifold), or as reported by the venue.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: True once the event has stopped trading.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: The event's first outcomes (markets) with their prices: traded in the last 24 hours first, then by probability. Empty when outcomesPerEvent is 0.

outcomeName.description: Outcome label, or the market's question when it has none.

outcomeProbability.description: Probability of the market's first outcome (usually YES), 0 to 1.

outcomeChange24h.description: Change over 24 hours, in probability units.

outcomeVolume24h.description: Market volume over 24 hours, in the venue's own unit.

outcomesTotal.title: Outcomes in event
outcomesTotal.description: How many outcomes the event has in all.

venueUrl.title: Venue page
venueUrl.description: The event's page on the venue.

citeAs.title: Citation
citeAs.description: A ready-made sentence to quote the leading outcome with its source and date.

asOf.title: As of
asOf.description: When pdata.world served these numbers, ISO 8601 UTC.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: Credit line required by the CC BY 4.0 licence.
